llm.summary: This is a disclosed router/onboarding skill for an AI content and business workflow, with local reading and limited persistence that fit its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The family instructions read config.yaml, configured vault paths, skill memory, empirical-rule files, and installed skill descriptions. That is proportionate for a personalized workflow router, but users should expect local project/vault data to be consulted.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown plus one local shell script. The script only enumerates installed aikey-family skills and descriptions from expected local skill directories; there is no downloader, package install, remote execution, or install-time persistence.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It has broad natural-language triggers and can route or hand off to other aikey skills, but it repeatedly limits the entry skill to routing, prompt generation, user-visible choices, and following the user's language.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The shared family rules allow writing drafts, content units, and memory records when outputs or user corrections warrant it; this is disclosed and scoped to the configured vault, with no services, scheduled jobs, credential use, or hidden background persistence found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill presents itself as the AI KEY entry point for routing users to content and business sub-skills, generating copyable prompts, and offering a short no-write onboarding demo; the inspected artifacts consistently support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that this skill is meant to inspect your local aikey setup, read configured project/vault files, and may write drafts or memory records as part of the broader aikey workflow. Review config.yaml paths so it only uses the workspace you intend.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The cited instruction tells the agent to fully read a selected downstream skill's SKILL.md and direct references before composing a routing prompt. The packaged referenced files were available for inspection here, and no hidden remote payload or evasion behavior was found.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger examples are real, but they match this skill's role as a top-level entry point. The artifact scopes activation to routing, prompt generation, or a no-write tutorial rather than silently executing high-impact workflows.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese style guidance appears in the reference material, but the main skill and interaction spec explicitly say to answer in the user's language. I did not find evidence that it forces a locale against user intent.
